stem: Maturity observations within one crop show different trichome states by genotype, flower position and plant age. Which harvest-readiness method is most defensible?
choices: Use one universal cloudy-to-amber percentage for every crop
Use a representative sampling plan and interpret trichome observations with genotype, age, morphology and product objectives
Use the oldest calendar date only
Sample one top flower and apply it to the whole lot
rationale: Trichome development is heterogeneous and influenced by genotype and age. Representative sampling is stronger than a universal color-percentage rule.
